No files edited. One existing user change is present in [narrative.rs](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:1209).

**Findings**
1. Run attach starts narrative provider refreshes as background Tokio jobs, but it does not stream them.
   In [attach_tui_with_parent](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:26288), the loop polls the run, tails events/spend/traces, then calls [poll_run_narrative_refresh_job](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:26347). That poll only checks `handle.is_finished()` in [poll_run_narrative_refresh_job](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:7070); if not finished, it returns `None`.

2. Refresh jobs are spawned by [start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:6963). If one is already active, new requests are only coalesced into a notice at [main.rs:6968](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:6968). There is no follow-up refresh after the active job finishes, so newer evidence that arrived while the provider was running can be lost.

3. The provider output file is written only after provider process completion.
   `refresh_narrative_projection_with_provider` awaits `router.complete(...)` at [main.rs:30115](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:30115). CLI providers call `run_cli`, then `write_output` only after the subprocess returns, e.g. [cli_claude_code.rs:48](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon-providers/src/cli_claude_code.rs:48) and [cli_claude_code.rs:58](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon-providers/src/cli_claude_code.rs:58). `run_cli_with_options` uses `wait_with_output()` at [cli_common.rs:143](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon-providers/src/cli_common.rs:143), and [write_output](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon-providers/src/cli_common.rs:271) writes one complete body with `tokio::fs::write`.

4. The TUI can overwrite a fresh provider snapshot with deterministic fallback as soon as coverage changes.
   [ensure_run_projection](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:423) builds a deterministic projection, then only reuses the current projection if [read_current_projection_if_covered](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:1335) says coverage matches. If coverage differs, it persists the deterministic projection at [narrative.rs:431](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:431). Deterministic projections explicitly add the fallback risk at [narrative.rs:648](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:648) and mark source/status deterministic at [narrative.rs:716](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:716).

5. Run `733da121` shows exactly that failure mode.
   `provider-refresh.out` was written at local `May 27 17:37:12 2026`. `snapshots.jsonl` has fresh provider snapshot `nar-3fe1ea6515db` at `2026-05-27T21:37:12.100350Z`, covering flight seq `162`. It was followed 36 ms later by deterministic snapshot `nar-e0792bdbd3d3` at `2026-05-27T21:37:12.136340Z`, covering flight seq `188`, then another deterministic snapshot at `21:37:40`. Current `narrative/state.json` points to deterministic `nar-0a80d194d0b4`.

6. Detaching cancels in-flight narrative refresh.
   On run TUI exit, [attach_tui_with_parent](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:26509) calls [cancel_run_narrative_refresh_job](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:7112), which cancels the token and aborts the task. Plan attach does the same at [main.rs:25630](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/main.rs:25630).

**Concrete Changes**
- Preserve provider snapshots separately from deterministic projections. Add `latest_provider_snapshot_id` or equivalent, and make render prefer the latest provider snapshot when deterministic coverage advances, marking it stale instead of replacing it with fallback.
- After a provider job completes, if requests were coalesced or coverage advanced, immediately enqueue a follow-up refresh using the latest run input.
- Include narrative state/snapshot mtime in `AttachNarrativeProjectionCache`, or explicitly load the persisted provider projection on completion before `ensure_run_projection` can rewrite state.
- For true streaming, add a provider streaming path/callback. `run_cli_with_options` would need to read stdout incrementally instead of `wait_with_output`, append chunks to `provider-refresh.out`, and the TUI would need to tail/render partial provider text. Trusted narrative claims should still only update after JSON validates.
- If users expect narration to finish after detaching, stop aborting refresh on `q`, or split “detach” from “cancel refresh”. That needs pid/cost cleanup policy.

**Risks**
- Streaming raw provider text bypasses current full-output redaction in [apply_provider_response](/Users/gdc/deadreckon/crates/deadreckon/src/narrative.rs:1222).
- Partial JSON is not reliable as cited narrative unless the provider protocol changes to validated JSONL patches.
- Preserving stale provider prose can mislead unless the UI clearly labels the covered seq/window and newer un-narrated evidence.
- Letting refresh survive detach can leak provider processes or spend without a lifecycle owner.
